# Roadmap

English | [Srpski](roadmap.sr.md)

Ultimate Prompt Library is an ever-growing library. This roadmap shows what is available, what is already planned with reserved IDs, and which collections come next. Planned prompts are never counted as available.

The planning source of truth is [`catalog.json`](../catalog.json); the tables below are generated from it and from prompt front matter by `npm run generate`.

## Phase 1 - Initial IT Collection

**Scope:** 100 prompts in [IT, Programming & Technology](../prompts/en/01-it-programming-technology/README.md), IDs `UPL-IT-001` to `UPL-IT-100`, across ten subcategories of ten prompts each.

| Numbers | Subcategory |
|---|---|
| 001-010 | Web Development |
| 011-020 | Mobile Development |
| 021-030 | Backend & API |
| 031-040 | Cybersecurity |
| 041-050 | DevOps, Cloud & Infrastructure |
| 051-060 | Databases & Data Engineering |
| 061-070 | AI, LLM & Automation |
| 071-080 | Testing, QA & Reliability |
| 081-090 | UX, UI & Product Development |
| 091-100 | Desktop, Game, Systems & Embedded |

Phase 1 is complete: all 100 prompts are published in English and Serbian. After Phase 1, the IT collection continues with `101`, `102`, … without restarting numbering per subcategory.

### Remaining planned prompts

Prompts that have a reserved ID, title and filename but are not written yet are listed here. To write one, open an issue or pull request that references its ID - see [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).

<!-- UPL:BEGIN roadmap-planned (generated by `npm run index`; do not edit by hand) -->
Every catalogued prompt is available. New entries are added to `catalog.json` as they are planned.

## Beyond the prompts

- **Website:** the folder layout and the generated indexes in [`indexes/`](../indexes/) are designed so a future website can offer category and subcategory filters, search, language switching, prompt detail pages, copy buttons, versions, statuses and permalinks by ID. The website will be a separate step; the repository stays Markdown + metadata.
- **More languages:** the tooling reads the language list from `catalog.json`, so additional languages can be added without restructuring.
